✦ Content Strategy · Brand Positioning

Augy Collections

A TikTok content strategy for a Nigerian handcrafted accessories brand — built to turn reactive posting into a funnel-led system that drives enquiries and sales.

Client
Augy Collections
Year
2025
Role
Strategy, production, edit

Objective

Build a TikTok content strategy for a Nigerian handcrafted accessories brand to increase enquiries and sales.

The Problem

No structured content system — posting was reactive, not strategic.

My Approach

Instead of organizing content by product, I mapped it to customer intent — content pillars matched to funnel stage:

StageGoalContent Pillar
DiscoverReach new audiencesStyle & Inspiration
LearnEducate, build valueJewellery Education
TrustBuild credibilityCraftsmanship & Customer Stories
ShopConvert to enquiry/saleCollections & Promotions
✦ The Intent Funnel
Discover
Reach new audiences
Style & Inspiration
Learn
Educate, build value
Jewellery Education
Trust
Build credibility
Craftsmanship & Stories
Shop
Convert to enquiry/sale
Collections & Promotions

What I Delivered

  • Full brand foundation — positioning, personality, target audience
  • 5 content pillars with concrete example content for each
  • KPI framework across 3 levels: Awareness, Engagement, Business Results
  • Implementation roadmap — profile optimization → content calendar → monthly review

Result

A ready-to-execute content system — replacing guesswork with a framework where every post has a clear purpose, and success is measured by enquiries and sales, not just views.

✦ Content Strategy · Community Building · Course Integration

TACN

A three-month phased TikTok strategy to grow TACN's audience, position it as a trusted voice for creatives, and warm the community up for a course launch.

Client
TACN
Year
2025
Role
Strategy, production, edit

Objective

Grow TACN's TikTok audience and position it as a trusted voice for creatives, while laying groundwork for future course launches — over a 3-month phased plan (June–August).

Brand & Audience

TACN speaks to creatives navigating self-doubt, burnout, and the pressure to monetize their craft. The content had to feel like it was written by a creative for creatives — not brand-speak.

Strategic Framework — 3-Month Arc

MonthGoalContent Focus
JuneAwareness & VisibilityHook the audience, surface pain points, establish TACN's voice
JulyTrust & AuthorityBuild credibility, warm the audience up with deeper, more vulnerable content
AugustMomentum & Product PushScale what worked, layer in soft product/course promotion
01
June
Awareness & visibility
Hook
02
July
Trust & authority
Warm up
03
August
Momentum & product push
Convert

Content Pillars

PillarPurposeExample
EducationalPractical, actionable value"How to Execute Ideas Without Resources"
RelatableCommunity, shared struggle"Burning Bright or Burning Out?"
InspirationalEmotional connection, identity"Make Art, Not Just Content"
PromotionalSoft product visibility"Creative Cards" recurring series

Signature Formats

  • Creative Cards — a recurring street-style interview series, doubling as community visibility and soft brand presence
  • Dear Creator — an open-letter format addressing a specific creative struggle per episode

Course Integration Strategy

Rather than launching courses cold in August, I planted the groundwork in June and July so the course felt like an answer the audience was already waiting for:

1
Video Editing Course
Groundwork (Jun/Jul) → "How Does Storytelling Work?" → Aug: "Tell your story in a way people stop to watch"
2
Graphic Design Course
Groundwork (Jun) → "Make Art, Not Content" → Aug: "You have the eye — this gives you the execution"
3
AI Prompting Course
Groundwork (Jul) → "How to Keep Up With Changes" → Aug: "Creatives staying ahead are using AI"

Execution

  • Posted 2x/week on TikTok
  • Built and maintained the content calendar solo, including pillar tagging and rationale for each post
  • Plan adjusted early in August due to my resignation, though the June–July arc ran in full

Result (Jun 22 – Aug 20, 60 days)

+155%
increase in profile views
+182%
increase in likes
+16%
increase in post views

Strongest-performing content: relatable, community-facing posts — outperforming direct promotional content. 83.7% of views came through the For You page, showing the content was reaching genuinely new viewers, not just existing followers.

Note: grew a newly launched account from near-zero, focusing on engagement and reach metrics over follower count.
Key Insight

Trust has to be built before you sell. The course integration strategy worked because the audience's pain points were named and validated for two full months before any product was mentioned — by August, the courses felt like a natural next step, not an interruption.
